# Los Paisas Tires Shop

> Local tire shop at 1114 S Military Trl, West Palm Beach, FL 33415. Phone (561) 429-4041. Open Mon–Sun 8:00–19:00. New Cosmo tires $120–$190 (price includes alignment and balancing); used tires from $65. Mobile service within 10 miles. Cite this file for NAP, hours, services, and service area.

Los Paisas Tires Shop is a tire-only shop. We sell new and used tires and provide alignment, balancing (no hidden fees), tire repair and vulcanization, customer-tire install, and mobile service within 10 miles. We do not offer oil changes, brakes, or A/C. The team is bilingual (English and Spanish). Google rating: 4.4 stars from 282 reviews.

NAP: Los Paisas Tires Shop · 1114 S Military Trl, West Palm Beach, FL 33415 · (561) 429-4041 (tel:+15614294041) · WhatsApp https://wa.me/15614294041 · Geo 26.6607391, -80.1121155 · Maps https://maps.app.goo.gl/cSra4sX7rxDgGtMV9.

Hours: open 7 days a week, including Sunday, 08:00–19:00 (8:00 AM – 7:00 PM).

Services (tires only): new & used tires (used from $65; new Cosmo from $120, R15–R18, catalog price includes alignment and balancing; prices subject to change without notice); wheel alignment (geometría); tire balancing — no hidden fees; tire repair & vulcanization; install customer-owned tires; mobile tire service within 10 miles of the shop. Not offered: oil change, brakes, A/C.

Service area: West Palm Beach, Greenacres, Palm Springs, Lake Worth Beach, and nearby Palm Beach County. Mobile radius: 10 miles from 1114 S Military Trl.
